handler.description: Configuration for the handler deployed by the operator.

namespace.description: Namespace the operator creates and deploys the handler into.

prefix.description: Optional name prefix for handler resources. When empty, the HANDLER_PREFIX environment variable is omitted.

imageEnvVar.description: Operator environment variable carrying the handler image. Downstream distributions can override it, for example with HANDLER_IMAGE. An empty value uses RELATED_IMAGE_HANDLER_IMAGE.

plugin.description: Console plugin configuration for OpenShift distributions.

image.description: Console plugin image. When empty, the PLUGIN_IMAGE environment variable is omitted.

createNamespace.description: Emit a Namespace object for the release namespace. Used by the manifest rendering pipeline; Helm users should use --create-namespace instead.

enabled.description: Create an NMState custom resource named nmstate to trigger handler deployment.

spec.description: Passthrough for NMState spec fields, including nodeSelector, tolerations, infraNodeSelector, and infraTolerations. These fields are validated by the NMState CRD.
